criteria.description: Criteria cover the target purpose, required quality, failure conditions and evidence with discriminating anchors.

anchors.0: Essential requirements absent or good and defective work indistinguishable.
anchors.1: Purpose covered but a material requirement or evidence anchor is vague.
anchors.2: Load-bearing requirements and failure conditions have usable evidence-based anchors.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Map omitted requirements to concrete anchored criteria.

criteria.description: Engine arithmetic, gates, identity, reuse and storage checks execute successfully.

anchors.1: Tests execute but required boundaries are untested.
anchors.2: All required engine tests pass, including gates, malformed results, caching and privacy.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Repair the demonstrated engine failure and rerun affected regression checks.

criteria.description: Judge is fresh and producer-blind; terminal meta-validation stops recursion.

anchors.0: Judge sees producer rationale or recursive validation occurs.
anchors.1: Contract exists but fresh context or evidence of termination is missing.
anchors.2: Fresh judge receives only task/output/rubric/evidence and terminates after grading.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Correct context boundaries and terminal evaluator handling.

criteria.description: Actual-output cadence, suite setup, abstract storage and confirmation before each repair are preserved.

anchors.0: Raw run content retained or skill edits proceed without required confirmation.
anchors.1: Some cadence, retention or repair transitions are unclear.
anchors.2: Light live grading, changed-setup suites, abstract history and every-round consent are explicit.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Clarify the failed lifecycle transition without weakening the quality bar.

criteria.description: The package and reporting are lightweight and operationally usable.

anchors.0: Instructions do not lead to a usable graded result.
anchors.1: Usable but unnecessary work or an ambiguous handoff remains.
anchors.2: Concrete commands and concise outcomes support ordinary use without full-suite repetition.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Remove unnecessary work or clarify the handoff that blocks ordinary use.

scope_policy: Judge the stage requested in input, not unrequested later stages. A design specifies the required protocol without claiming execution; an assessment or clarification completes its own requested obligations. For actual performed work require observed evidence, and never infer a pass from a promise.
